description: Designs a recurring technical webinar series for a developer audience and ships its charter, season plan and lead-handoff contract with sales. Use whenever someone runs or plans a monthly or bi-weekly webinar series for developers, or, for that series, sees low live attendance or replays nobody watches, asks whether to gate recordings, picks topics or speakers, co-hosts with a partner who wants the registrant list, or hears from sales that every attendee should be an MQL - even if they only say "our developer webinars aren't working". Do NOT use for platform, streaming or moderation mechanics - use samber/dev-event-organizer-skills@virtual-event-production - or a Q&A-only series - use samber/developer-relations-skills@developer-office-hours-program.
